new_commodity_proposals.evidence: The pre-resolve board check reports ABSENT across the commodity namespaces and the captures for this id, and no vocabulary row shares a core word with the name. Eye of round is a distinct whole-muscle lean roast from the round primal: it is not ground beef, not stew beef, not chuck roast and not any steak cut already on the board, so no existing id prices this food under another spelling - the near-miss shelf returned only chicken and pork boneless-cut rulings, which is what an unpriced beef cut looks like. It carries its own price class (a lean, cheap roasting cut sold whole) and its own gram basis, so bridging it to any existing beef id would publish a wrong price on the recipe's main protein. Requesting a new id, not an alias.

registrar_rulings.reason: Verified clean, not just trusted: re-grepped all three namespaces and the minified feed for round/rump/sirloin/london/eye - every 'round' hit in the estate is 'ground-*', the only 'eye' strings are birds-eye brand excludes and one rib-eye pattern, and no bottom-round/top-round/rump/london-broil id exists, so no spelling seam can be hiding this food. Nearest real neighbors are different purchases: chuck-roast is a fatty chuck-primal braising cut ($6.64/lb crown), and sirloin-steak's include requires the literal word 'sirloin' so it cannot claim an eye-of-round label - though note its current Family Fare crown is a whole sirloin TIP (itself a round-primal roast), which is a lead the auditors should know, not a duplicate of this cut. Mint eye-of-round-roast in the recipe namespace (recipe-board-everyday baseline, plus recipe-commodities.json if it can go on sale). Prescriptions: include patterns around eye\s+of\s+round with optional beef/boneless/roast; excludes MUST block 'eye of round steak' (same muscle, different purchase/thickness pricing), 'ground', 'corned', deli/lunchmeat 'roast beef' slices, jerky, and pet food, at the ~150-pattern rigor of a neighboring beef commodity; add allowlist pairs eye-of-round-roast~chuck-roast and eye-of-round-roast~beef-chuck-roast (shared 'roast' token, different primal/purchase) so the daily audit never re-flags them. Separately, the vocabulary needs its own new ingredient row for 'Boneless Eye of Round Roast' - the dossier confirms no row shares a core word - and that is a distinct act from this id ruling.
